episode.logline: Dry British fantasy satire with slapstick visual timing

scenes.heading: INT. FORGOTTEN CITADEL THRONE ROOM - MORNING
scenes.action: Sunbeams slice through mossy gothic arches. SIR PIP (20s, earnest squire in oversized dented pauldrons) polishes a rusted bronze crown with a turnip cloth. Beside him, GLOOP (translucent emerald slime familiar wearing a tiny monocle) bubbles skeptically. Behold, Gloop! According to the Royal Inventory of 842, whoever buffs the Crown of Eldoria inherits the entire Kingdom... and its tax exemptions. And according to the foreclosure notice nailed to the drawbridge, we owe the Stone Golem three hundred turnips by noon.

scenes.heading: INT. FORGOTTEN CITADEL THRONE ROOM - CONTINUOUS
scenes.action: Sir Pip buffs a stubborn smudge. A hidden rune flares gold! The ancient STONE GOLEM BAILIFF (3 meters tall, mossy basalt plates, glowing amber eyes) rumbles awake behind the throne, holding a stone clipboard. CITIZEN DETECTED. CROWN ACTIVATION FEE: FORTY GOLD COINS. WOULD YOU LIKE TO PAY BY COIN OR CATAPULT EJECTION? Aha! Good morning, Officer! Does the Crown's warranty cover... spontaneous abdication?
